scripts.setup: pnpm install && uv sync --directory apps/core && pnpm tool:install && uv run --directory apps/core stash install-skills --workspace && node scripts/changelog.mjs
scripts.lint: uv run --no-sync --directory apps/core ruff check && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --no-sync --directory apps/core pyright && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.format: uv run --no-sync --directory apps/core ruff format && pnpm --filter web format
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory apps/core stash openapi > apps/web/openapi.json && pnpm --filter web gen:api
